title: Synchronize OpenCode combined-config test before checking output
outcome: Required Rust gate failed in opencode_combined_model_and_effort_update_waits_for_model_specific_options. start_acp_json_rpc_request publishes pending before writing bytes. The test takes pending then reads writer.contents before worker join, so the effort write is not ordered before its assertion. Test synchronization defect; move unchanged output assertions after acknowledgement and join.
acceptance: Existing combined-config test preserves model-before-effort and xhigh assertions, reads completed writer output, and full Rust gate passes.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure.
